estimand: pelvic-floor-related ambulatory office visits (UI/POP/pelvic-floor ICD-10 in DIAG1-3); all-provider, condition-defined
source: National Ambulatory Medical Care Survey (NAMCS) 2019 Public Use File, NCHS/CDC
definition: Any of DIAG1/DIAG2/DIAG3 beginning with an ICD-10-CM prefix in URPS_ICD10_PREFIXES: N393, N394, N81, N3281, R32, N993, N994
limitations: Office-based only (excludes HOPD/ED) -> structural lower bound; 2019 vintage; 55 unweighted records (>= NCHS floor 30); all-provider condition-defined, not FPMRS-specialist.
